# SkaleSeed

> SkaleSeed is a web design, web app, AI and digital marketing studio in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It builds websites, SaaS platforms, AI assistants and automation, and runs Meta ads, SEO and Instagram content for small and growing businesses. Clients see a free demo page with their business name before paying anything.

## Key facts

- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Works with businesses across India and abroad.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 95156 47977 · Email skaleseed@gmail.com · Free demo: https://www.skaleseed.com/contact
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/skaleseed
- Services: websites, web apps and SaaS, AI assistants and automation, Meta ads, local and technical SEO, AI search readiness, Instagram content.
- Process: 1) free demo page, 2) build, 3) launch on the client's own domain, 4) grow with ads, content and automation.
- Pricing: quoted per project after the free demo; clients own their domain and ad accounts.

## Case studies

- [ElastoMech](https://www.skaleseed.com/work/elastomech) (live: https://www.elastomech.in/): industrial safety and rubber products platform; traffic up 180%, leads up 250%, 15+ industrial clients in the first quarter.
- [PropaTrade](https://www.skaleseed.com/work/propatrade) (live: https://propatrade.com/): multilingual AI voice assistant built into the website; longer sessions and fewer repetitive support questions.
- [ClassVerse](https://www.skaleseed.com/work/classverse) (live: https://www.class-verse.com/): AI and no-code learning platform; enrolment up 300%, workshop attendance up 85%.
- [Sunrise Interiors](https://www.skaleseed.com/work/sunrise-interiors) (live: https://sunriseinteriors.org/): portfolio website for an interior designer in Markapur with 120+ projects; WhatsApp enquiries and local SEO.
- [ZeroX](https://www.skaleseed.com/work/zerox): queue-free campus stationery and printing at NIT Warangal; 800+ users and 600+ orders in the first week.
- [TradingFloor](https://www.skaleseed.com/work/tradingfloor): private copy-trading SaaS for futures and options that executes one strategy across all client accounts at once.
- [AI lead agent](https://www.skaleseed.com/work/ai-lead-agent): product-aware AI agent that finds high-intent customers and starts personalised outreach.
